mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for future corporate earnings and increasing the present value of equities, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods when FEDFUNDS declines, as measured by a t-test p-value > 0.05 or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200k per month signals strong labor market demand, which supports consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 50% of instances when PAYEMS exceeds 200.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and residential investment signals weakening demand for durable goods and construction, which reduces near-term corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the interaction signal fails to produce a Rank IC > 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production below 104.0 for two consecutive months indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, which signals weakening economic momentum and reduced corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the consumer price index above 2.5% year-over-year, combined with a stable federal funds rate, signals inflationary pressure that may trigger a future rate hike, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction signal fails to achieve a Rank IC > 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real personal consumption expenditures (as proxied by RSAFS) combined with a drop in housing starts signals a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue visibility and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both RSAFS and HOUST decline, or the interaction signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the unemployment rate above 3.6% and a decline in non-farm payrolls below 150k signals a labor market deterioration that reduces consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the interaction signal fails to produce a Rank IC > 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth below 1.0% annualized, as measured by the most recent quarterly data, signals a weakening economy that reduces corporate earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when GDPC1 < 1.0, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
